firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently saw an island goes first.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, the timing is tied or unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: The rule says seeing an island; it does not require landing on or visiting one.
Individual turns proceed clockwise, with movement, revealing a location card, and one action in that order.
For solo play, control two or more characters of your choice.
